up: Return the first 1000 activity rows for the target CHEMBL2717. Include only rows where the standard type is IC50, the standard relation is exactly '=', and the pChEMBL value is not null. For each row, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_matches AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id FROM target_dictionary td WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2717' ), molecule_info AS ( SELECT md.molregno, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno ) SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, tm.target_type, tm.tax_id, mi.canonical_smiles, mi.molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_matches tm ON ass.tid = tm.tid JOIN molecule_info mi ON a.molregno = mi.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mi.molecule_chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
